errors.text_span: Цветът на стълбовете постепенно изсветлява от 2012 към 2020 г., следвайки реда на легендата.
errors.evidence: The description states that the color of the bars gradually lightens from 2012 to 2020, but this is incorrect. The colors lighten from 2012 to 2016, but then become dark again for 2018 (darkest) and 2020 (dark).
The description omits the units of the y-axis. The figure caption specifies that the values represent "брой страни" (number of countries), which is essential context for the chart.

errors.text_span: като категориите са изброени в постоянен ред
errors.evidence: The phrase "in constant order" is vague. A more precise description would be that the categories are ordered by increasing EGDI level.
